why: The paved drive from a Bhagwan Das Road gate to the bungalow forecourt north-east of the road: clear on the satellite view (a pale gravel drive that leaves the road side, passes the north-west side of the outhouse and ends in the forecourt with parked cars), missing from OSM. One service lane, free at the forecourt end.

reference.note: Esri World Imagery, zoom 19 tile 374626 x 218608: the drive leg is plain where it leaves the canopy; its first 30 m from the road gate are under trees.
